title: My hometown
simplified_paragraphs: 我的家乡在农村， 那里有很多动物和植物。 我家养了一群羊、 两匹马、 三头牛， 还有四只鸡和六只鸭， 鱼塘里也有很多条鱼。 我的弟弟还养了一条蛇， 我一直很害怕。 我家的院子很大， 一半种花， 一半种菜。 每到春天， 花全开了， 五颜六色， 每一朵都又香又美。 如果去朋友家吃饭， 我们总会送给朋友们一束花。 我家的院子一年四季都种不同的菜， 如果有客人来家里， 总能吃到最新鲜的蔬菜。 我又开始想念我的家乡和家人了！
traditional_paragraphs: 我的家鄉在農村， 那裏有很多動物和植物。 我家養了一群羊、 兩匹馬、 三頭牛， 還有四隻雞和六隻鴨， 魚塘裡也有很多條魚。 我的弟弟還養了一條蛇， 我一直很害怕。 我家的院子很大， 一半種花， 一半種菜。 每到春天， 花全開了， 五顏六色， 每一朵都又香又美。 如果去朋友家吃飯， 我們總會送給朋友們一束花。 我家的院子一年四季都種不同的菜， 如果有客人來家裡， 總能吃到最新鮮的蔬菜。 我又開始想念我的家鄉和家人了！
pinyin_paragraphs: wǒ de jiā xiāng zài nóng cūn，  nà lǐ yǒu hěn duō dòng wù hé zhí wù。  wǒ jiā yǎng le yī qún yáng、  liǎng pǐ mǎ、  sān tóu niú，  hái yǒu sì zhī jī hé liù zhī yā，  yú táng lǐ yě yǒu hěn duō tiáo yú。  wǒ de dì di hái yǎng le yī tiáo shé，  wǒ yī zhí hěn hài pà。  wǒ jiā de yuàn zi hěn dà，  yī bàn zhòng huā，  yī bàn zhòng cài。  měi dào chūn tiān，  huā quán kāi le，  wǔ yán liù sè，  měi yī duǒ dōu yòu xiāng yòu měi。  rú guǒ qù péng you jiā chī fàn，  wǒ men zǒng huì sòng gěi péng you men yī shù huā。  wǒ jiā de yuàn zi yī nián sì jì dōu zhòng bù tóng de cài，  rú guǒ yǒu kè rén lái jiā lǐ，  zǒng néng chī dào zuì xīn xiān de shū cài。  wǒ yòu kāi shǐ xiǎng niàn wǒ de jiā xiāng hé jiā rén le！
english_paragraphs: My hometown is in the countryside, where there are many animals and plants. My family raises a group of sheep, two horses, three cows, four chickens and six ducks. There are also many fish in the fish pond. My brother also had a snake, which I was always afraid of. My yard is very big, half of it is planted with flowers and the other half with vegetables. Every spring, the flowers are in full bloom, colorful, and each one is fragrant and beautiful. If we go to a friend's house for dinner, we always give them a bouquet of flowers. My yard grows different vegetables all year round. If guests come to my house, they can always eat the freshest vegetables. I started to miss my hometown and family again!
english_full: My hometown is in the countryside, where there are many animals and plants. My family raises a group of sheep, two horses, three cows, four chickens and six ducks. There are also many fish in the fish pond. My brother also had a snake, which I was always afraid of. My yard is very big, half of it is planted with flowers and the other half with vegetables. Every spring, the flowers are in full bloom, colorful, and each one is fragrant and beautiful. If we go to a friend's house for dinner, we always give them a bouquet of flowers. My yard grows different vegetables all year round. If guests come to my house, they can always eat the freshest vegetables. I started to miss my hometown and family again!
